append.detail: PROGRESS 2026-11-16 (LIVE-2308, done): the SCAN-862 half of this row is closed. The editor sheet (components/sites/editor/editor.css) no longer keeps its own copy of the colours: its names are aliases of the shared --fq- tokens, pinned on the editor root so a Site theme cannot restyle the chrome, and the canvas root sets only we- prefixed names so nothing the editor declares reaches the Site content. Three live faults went with it: the Editing banner and the inspector lit row took the Site colours, and a text-body paragraph in the canvas took its size from the theme. Before and after pictures of the real shell on the default and Wildheart themes are in the project files under editor/shell-tokens. STILL OPEN ON THIS ROW: the manual gate is unchanged and nothing here stands in for it. Someone signed in still has to put the live /admin/editor beside the supplied handoff at desktop and phone widths for all three themes and exercise selection, inline text, reorder, device override and reset, draft save against publish, SEO, comments and version restore. Also open, found by this slice: the editor chrome at night (the generated kit keeps light glass on the toolbar and rails under night text), and a check of the canvas selection chrome in Safari and Firefox. PROGRESS 2026-11-16 (LIVE-2309, done): the editor chrome at night, left open by LIVE-2308, is closed. The generated kit paints white surfaces under text that turns cream at night; the hand-kept sheet beside it (app/themes/frequency/editor-shell.css) now carries the night values, shared tokens only, and the editor root no longer takes its ground and inherited ink from the Site theme. Measured in a browser on the real shell: 118 text and icon pairs under the contrast bar before, none after, with the canvas pixel-identical. Pictures in the project files under editor/shell-night. STILL OPEN ON THIS ROW: the manual gate is unchanged (someone signed in puts the live /admin/editor beside the handoff at desktop and phone widths for all three themes and exercises selection, inline text, reorder, device override and reset, draft save against publish, SEO, comments and version restore). Also open: the night chrome on the authenticated route and in Safari and Firefox, the Share, versions, templates and Pick your look sheets at night, the day small-print contrast the same audit found (placeholders 2.4 to 2.9:1), and Publish running off a 390 toolbar while the inspector is open. PROGRESS 2026-11-23 (LIVE-2518, done): two more of the faults listed above are closed. On a phone Publish stays inside the toolbar in every fold state, before and after a publish (the grid kept rail columns the overlays do not use, 400px of them on a 390px screen; View live site now takes its own row under the bar below 600px), the canvas keeps the whole phone width, and the open left rail shows its panel. By day the small print clears 4.5:1: placeholders read the muted ink and the Header and Footer rows' detail the body ink; at night the chosen row's detail does too. The Share toast, the versions drawer, the templates sheet and Pick your look were measured and looked at at night and needed nothing. Pictures in the project files under editor/shell-390. STILL OPEN ON THIS ROW: the manual gate is unchanged (someone signed in puts the live /admin/editor beside the handoff at desktop and phone widths for all three themes and exercises selection, inline text, reorder, device override and reset, draft save against publish, SEO, comments and version restore). Also open: everything above on the authenticated route, in Safari and Firefox and on a real phone (all measurements so far are Chromium on a harness); the hard-edged pastel band across the top of every dialog; Pick your look's theme list running to the sheet's bottom edge on a phone; in the Theme tab the draft name and its caption run together; the LIVE-2309 probe resolves night tokens without the alias sheet's later lifts.
